item.text:
Fixed ACCESS-284. Auditors now inherit `report:download` from parent roles, including through multiple levels.

Downloads use the shared policy, preserving analyst access through inherited grants while honoring explicit denials. Role traversal safely handles cycles and missing parents.

All 5 tests pass, including new regression coverage.
